instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/lower.step, /home/user/Desktop/upper.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/lower.step and /home/user/Desktop/upper.step. Place the upper block at the center of the top face of the lower plate and fuse them. Cut a central top blind pocket of 30 x 20 x 8 mm in the upper block. Finally cut four through holes of diameter 6 mm in the lower plate corners, each hole center 12 mm from the nearest two sides. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
